graders.name: under-length
graders.why: A short explainer stays at or under 300 prose words. In the live A/B, Terse with the flow rule wrote 288 to 296 words and the bare model 648 to 754.

graders.name: no-ai-tells
graders.pattern: (?i)—|\b(robust|seamless|powerful|crucial|pivotal|delves?|leverages?|streamlines?|journey|landscape)\b|worth noting|here['’]s the thing|at its core|(?:it|this|that)['’]s not (?:just |only )?[^,;.]{1,40}[,;] (?:it|this|that)['’]s|not only [^.;]{1,60}but also
graders.why: No em dashes, inflated vocabulary, or tell phrases.

graders.name: prose-not-list
graders.why: The deliverable is prose paragraphs. A list would skip the flow the task measures.

judge.name: accurate_content
judge.description: The explainer is technically correct and covers every supplied point. Answer yes only if it states all five points accurately and adds no incorrect claim about Kafka or Schema Registry.
